summary: Stardew Valley-inspired character design for 4 AI companions (Byte, Sage, Luma, Flint). Each has a surface personality, hidden depth, visual description, personality quirks, context-aware dialogue tables, time-of-day personality shifts, and a 5-level relationship/heart system with unique heart events. Implementation uses static JSON dialogue pools, no LLM calls. Core design pillar: characters have contradictions and opinions, not just vibes.
